packageRules.description: Group the stylelint stack into one update PR: core and config packages release in lockstep and each config major pins the matching core major as a peer dependency (stylelint 18 and stylelint-config-standard 41 are co-released majors that each fail CI alone when split, see PRs #738 and #740).

Bump `overrides` entries in package.json instead of lockfile-only updates. npm install with an explicit package argument fails with EOVERRIDE when the package is overridden but is not a direct dependency (see PR #658).
